name: Remove Curse
description: Level 3 Abjuration (Doctor, Warden, Warlock, Shipwright) Casting Time: Action Range: Touch Components: V, S Duration: Instantaneous At your touch, all curses affecting one creature or object end. If the object is a cursed magic item, its curse remains, but the spell breaks its owner's Attunement to the object so it can be removed or discarded.
